http/internal/wire_bytes#

Joining byte chunks into one bounded buffer.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Joining byte chunks into one bounded buffer.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

object HttpWireBytes#

object HttpWireBytes

Bounded in-memory concatenation through the existing native buffer boundary. No interpreted per-octet callback and no new provider or transport effect.
